_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Apprentice robots (spec sections 3 and 14): a small crew, about 12 at the ending, every robot a decision. Robots and their repairs cost PARTS only. mastery_speed: a robot works a kind at rate x (base + per_level x Lumi's mastery of that kind), and not at all below min_level. near_bonus: extra speed for crew in the district Lumi is in (the simulator treats the whole current district as 'within 80 m'). crew_cap: most robots in all at base level 1..6. haul_share: share of Lumi's bale carrying one hauler takes over. Tiers on Planet 1: rusty (as built) and repaired; repaired_mult = a repaired robot's work speed; repair_requires = the id that opens repairs. types: kinds = pollution kinds the type can work; rate = units a second per rusty robot at speed 1.0; water_rate / plant_rate = hexes a second a tender waters or plants (planting uses seeds); hauls = carries Lumi's bales; mods = stat multipliers while at least one is owned (the Scrounger marks buried parts for Lumi to dig: it raises Lumi's Parts yield, it collects nothing); parts = Parts for the first one; parts_step = Parts added for each one already owned; repair_parts = Parts to repair one robot of the type; max = most of that type on Planet 1; requires = id that must be owned; district = index of the district that must be open. Base levels also raise crew speed (upgrades.json base_N mods).
